release_notes: Updater + radio fix release: framework-aware migration runner (--run/--run-all ledger, idempotent, SQL+PHP), update.sh/check_update.sh auto-select PHP CLI with pdo_mysql (fixes 'could not find driver' on php8.5 default), FK-safe radio_streams sync migration (widens server_type/status to varchar, no more 1265/1701 errors), ships database/bootstrap.sql (api_keys/feature_lists base tables fix 'table doesn't exist' on fresh installs), helpers branding, installer PHP pinning, chat dashboard create, server overview checks.
